Base-RD payload fixtures generated by the FTE-derived independent writer in MVDSV:

Copied from the retained ezquake-fork wire fixtures, not generated by rtx-proto.
The files contain a UF payload, without an entity update index or svc opcode.
They exercise every base field except bones/reserved bits, at coord widths 2/4.

independent literal bytes in replacement_deltas.rs instead of the writer stub.

Regeneration from the MVDSV repository root with this test harness:
  cmake --build build/replacementdeltas/tests --target rd_fixtures
  build/replacementdeltas/tests/rd_fixtures <destination-directory>
